goal: Connect the current chat UI to the already-implemented reviewed ViewModel state without changing the ViewModel or adding features.
acceptance_criteria: Remove DemoCatalog imports/reads. Render a non-null snapshot of model.currentPlan, not a fixture. Use model.suggestedPrompts, whose exactly-three contract is already enforced by state.

The plan card shows its title and summary if nonblank, and all nonblank uncertainties as explicitly missing/uncertain information. Do not imply a partial documented plan is a full procedure. Preserve illustrative labeling when plan.illustrative is true.
Display the accepted plan's step titles and keep model.savePlan as the save action. Hide the card when currentPlan is null.
Show restrained Arabic busy feedback from model.isResponding; disable Send and Save while responding. Keep draft editable and visible so a user can prepare/correct text.
Preserve Navy/Sky theme, RTL, exactly three contextual suggestions, voice-first microphone placeholder, visible messages, optional keyboard, existing listening placeholder and all original callbacks.
Do not add audio implementation, network calls, tests, dependencies, procedural facts or new ViewModel methods. Include all required imports. Return small exact edits for this file only.
